standard.name: Standard calculator

favorites.limitReached_other: The free plan keeps {{count}} shortcuts. Remove one or go Premium for unlimited shortcuts.

errors.not_integer: Use a whole number in range
errors.incompatible_units: Compare weight with weight, volume with volume

help.increase: New value = value × (1 + percentage ÷ 100). Use a negative percentage to decrease.
help.change: Change = (to − from) ÷ |from| × 100. A positive result is an increase.
help.original: Original = price after discount ÷ (1 − discount ÷ 100). Useful to know the price before a sale.
help.margin: Margin is profit as a share of the selling price; markup is profit as a share of the cost.

vat.rateHint: The default rate can be changed in Settings.

help.stacked: Successive discounts multiply: −20 % then −10 % is −28 % overall, not −30 %.
help.vat: Including tax = before tax × (1 + rate). Before tax = including tax ÷ (1 + rate). Amounts are rounded to the cent for display only.
help.compare: Prices are converted to a price per kilogram, per litre or per piece so different pack sizes compare fairly.

tip.extraHint: Delivery, service fee… added before splitting.
tip.help: Exact split: leftover cents go to the first people so the shares always add up to the total. Rounded split: each share is rounded up and the extra is shown.

loan.disclaimer: Estimate for information only. This is not a credit offer or financial advice. Your lender's figures (insurance, fees, rate type) may differ.
loan.feesHint: Added to the total cost only.
loan.lastPaymentNote: The last payment is adjusted to {{amount}} so the balance ends at exactly zero.

schedule.title: Detailed amortization table
schedule.description: Every monthly payment split into interest and principal, with the remaining balance.

compare.title: Compare two loans
compare.description: See side by side how the rate or duration changes your payment and total interest.

prepay.title: Early repayment simulation
prepay.description: See how much interest a lump-sum repayment saves, with a shorter term or a lower payment.

compare.scenarioB: Scenario B (A is the loan above)

prepay.note: Lenders may charge prepayment penalties, which are not included.

loan.assumptions: Formula: M = P·i / (1 − (1 + i)^−n), with i = annual rate ÷ 12. The payment is rounded up to the cent, interest is rounded to the cent each month and the last payment is adjusted. Insurance, taxes and penalties are not included.

savings.rateHint: An estimate, not a guaranteed return.

gate.title: Detailed yearly table
gate.description: Deposits, interest and balance for each year of your plan.

savings.disclaimer: Projection for information only, not financial advice. Real returns vary and may be negative.
savings.assumptions: Constant rate of {{rate}} per year. With quarterly or yearly compounding, the equivalent monthly rate is used. No taxes, fees or inflation.

privacy.intro: CalcWise is built to work without collecting your data. Here is exactly what happens.

local.title: Your calculations stay on your phone
local.body: History, shortcuts and preferences are stored only on this device. CalcWise has no server and no cloud sync.

noAccount.title: No account
noAccount.body: You never need to sign up or give your name or email.

analytics.title: Optional anonymous statistics
analytics.body: Off by default. If you turn it on, only events such as “a tool was opened” are counted — never numbers, expressions, amounts or results.

ads.title: Ads in the free version
ads.body: Google AdMob shows ads and may use your device's advertising ID, according to your consent choices. Ads never appear on the keypad or over results.

purchases.title: Purchases
purchases.body: Premium is bought through Google Play. CalcWise only receives whether Premium is active, never your payment details.

delete.title: You're in control
delete.body: Delete single calculations, clear the history or erase everything from Settings at any time.
